items_flat.title_en: OpenAI drops GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API 與點數定價下調逾 20%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a promotional price reduction for GPT-5.6 Sol on the API and eligible ChatGPT Work/Codex credits: input now $4/M tokens and output $20/M tokens (roughly 20% lower input and 33% lower output). The promo runs at least through 21 November 2026; Pro/Plus/Business subscription usage limits are unchanged. The same day the company also enabled per-request regional processing for eligible Global-geography projects.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 API 與符合條件的 ChatGPT Work/Codex 點數上進行促銷降價：輸入 $4/M tokens、輸出 $20/M tokens（輸入約降 20%、輸出約降 33%）。促銷至少持續至 2026 年 11 月 21 日；Pro/Plus/Business 訂閱用量不變。同日亦開放符合條件的 Global 地理專案可依請求選擇區域處理。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cut improves Sol’s price-performance positioning against competing frontier models and may accelerate adoption for high-volume agentic and coding workloads. Duration and whether the lower rates become permanent remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此次降價強化 Sol 相對其他前沿模型的性價比定位，可能加速高用量代理與編碼工作負載採用。促銷期結束後是否轉為常態定價仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: As we continue to push the frontier of capabilities while improving efficiency, we're dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next 3 months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在持續推進能力前沿並提升效率的同時，我們將 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與點數定價在未來三個月下調逾 20%。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 現已上架 Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is available via Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform (Model Garden). The model retains its 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels (low/medium/high/xhigh) at $2 / $0.50 cached / $6 per million tokens. This expands enterprise distribution beyond the xAI API, Cursor, Grok Build, Bedrock and other partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已可透過 Google Enterprise Agent Platform（Model Garden）使用。模型維持 50 萬 token 上下文與可配置推理等級（low/medium/high/xhigh），定價為輸入 $2、快取輸入 $0.50、輸出 $6／百萬 tokens。此舉擴大企業通路，涵蓋 xAI API、Cursor、Grok Build、Bedrock 等之外的管道。
items_flat.analysis_en: Adding a major cloud provider channel lowers friction for Google Cloud customers already using agent platforms and increases competitive pressure on pricing and availability of frontier models across hyperscalers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 進入主要雲端代理平台可降低 Google Cloud 客戶採用門檻，並加劇超大規模雲端業者之間前沿模型價格與可用性競爭。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們很高興宣布，Grok 4.6 現已可在 Google Enterprise Agent Platform 上使用。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot expanded to more subscription plans
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot 擴大至更多訂閱方案
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI stated that Grok Bot (always-on AI teammates with their own computer) is now included with SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams plans, broadening access beyond the earlier limited rollout.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 表示 Grok Bot（具備專屬電腦的常駐 AI 隊友）現已納入 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 以及所有 Cursor Teams 方案，擴大早期有限推出後的可用範圍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Wider plan inclusion signals product maturation of persistent agent teammates and may drive higher engagement inside the Cursor and SuperGrok ecosystems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 擴大方案納入顯示常駐代理隊友產品趨於成熟，可能提升 Cursor 與 SuperGrok 生態系內的使用黏著度。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot is now available for SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams plans.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現已適用於 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 以及所有 Cursor Teams 方案。

brief_en: Quiet window. OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol API/credit pricing >20% for three months and added regional processing options. xAI made Grok 4.6 available on Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform. No major new model launches from the frontier labs in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: 平靜時段。OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API/點數定價下調逾20%（為期三個月）並新增區域處理選項；xAI 讓 Grok 4.6 上架 Google Enterprise Agent Platform。過去12小時無重大新模型發布。
